Callout.Name: Broken Down Vehicle
Callout.Message: Vehicle broken down in a live lane.
Callout.Advisory: Hazards on, driver standing behind the barrier.

Script.Line: It is in a live lane with the hazards on and I cannot get it moving.
I am behind the barrier. I am not standing in the lane.
The recovery is twenty minutes out. That is a long twenty minutes.

Lines.Approach: It is in a live lane with the hazards on. Get it moved before somebody else arrives.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
